channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: CoreWeave CEO Intrator tells CNBC he has canceled his planned share sale program
item.description: After CoreWeave beat on revenue and upped its forecast, CEO Mike Intrator indicated the company will be fine despite last week's Democratic midterm sweep.

item.title: Nvidia shares rebound as Jensen Huang faces scrutiny ahead of earnings
item.description: Investors are assessing whether CEO Jensen Huang's affair will have spillover effects on Nvidia's business.

item.title: Analysis: Is Nvidia too big to fail? Its AI financing web raises the stakes
item.description: The tech giant's web of ties to other companies is raising the possibility that it could do far-reaching economic and financial damage.

item.title: Fed's Goolsbee calls inflation report 'borderline disturbing' as central bank weighs more hikes
item.description: The consumer price index rose more than expected in October, raising alarm among Federal Reserve officials.

item.title: Bessent moved to military base amid 'growing threats' from Iran
item.description: Bessent's role leading Operation Economic Outcast has made him one of the Trump administration's top targets of Iranian threats, The New York Times reported.

item.title: Mississippi Senate: Scott Colom leads Hyde-Smith by more than 3,000 votes
item.description: Tuesday was the deadline for provisional ballots to be resolved in Mississippi, and the deadline for the receipt of mail-in absentee ballots.

item.title: Prediction markets tied to clinical trials and drug approvals draw lawmakers' ire
item.description: Sens. Angela Alsobrooks and Ron Wyden are asking what steps the Department of Health and Human Services has taken to mitigate risks from the markets.

item.title: American Airlines brings fresh food back to NY-Chicago first class for first time since 2019
item.description: American Airlines' first class food options include sandwiches, fruit and chia bowls

item.title: Bouncing Wynn Shares might be primed for the 'wheel strategy'
item.description: From a valuation standpoint, WYNN is trading very close to its five-year historical averages across key metrics. So how should traders play this setup?

item.title: Nvidia's Huang tries to project 'business as usual' in return to office after affair revelation
item.description: Nvidia employees described the mood as "sad" as CEO Jensen Huang returned to the office after disclosing an affair.

item.title: Measles is surging in the U.S. — and outbreaks can cost millions
item.description: A new tool developed by Johns Hopkins researchers estimates that the 2025 measles outbreak in the U.S. carried an economic cost of more than $37 million.

item.title: Meta head of infrastructure will leave and be succeeded by former AWS cloud exec
item.description: Meta's head of infrastructure and co-head of engineering Santosh Janardhan will leave in 2027, with former AWS senior vice president David Brown taking over.

item.title: JetBlue unveils new first class seats to bring back profits
item.description: JetBlue will give reporters a look at its new first class seats on Wednesday.

item.title: How Democrats could snarl Trump administration stakes in private sector companies
item.description: The Trump administration had established some form of equity position in 41 companies as of November, according to the CATO Institute's tally.

item.title: CFTC investigates if Kalshi improperly self-certified event contracts
item.description: News of the probe comes after the CFTC ordered Kalshi to take down a sports-related "mention markets" back in August.

item.title: WNBA Finals MVP Gabby Williams: 'Our existence is political'
item.description: Golden State Valkyries star Gabby Williams speaks about winning the WNBA championship, being named Finals MVP, and the culture war over women's sports.

item.title: Zelenskyy warns Ukraine is 'not real estate' as experts say a Russia peace deal remains elusive
item.description: President Zelenskyy warned Tuesday that his country "was not real estate," as a second and final day of U.S.-brokered peace talks got underway.

item.title: Jim Cramer's plan for our Intel position. Plus, a rotation loser to buy here
item.description: The Investing Club holds its "Morning Meeting" every weekday at 10:20 a.m. ET.

item.title: American soldier arrested on suspicion of spying for Russia
item.description: The 41-year-old man is being detained in London under the U.K.'s National Security Act.

item.title: Tired of spending time fixing other people's AI slop at work? How to talk to them about it
item.description: Executive coach Melody Wilding shares four ways to address the extra work landing on your plate without the conversation becoming confrontational.

item.title: General strikes to paralyze Spain as protestors clash with police ahead of election campaign
item.description: Spanish workers are expected to turn out in their millions on Wednesday for the country's first general strike in 14 years.

item.title: Nissan cuts sales forecast again on China woes as CEO outlines plan to fight back
item.description: Intensifying competition in the world's largest auto market forced Nissan to cut its annual sales forecast for a second time in months.

item.title: Rep. Jim Jordan, Sen. John Thune elected GOP leaders in Congress
item.description: House Speaker Mike Johnson, R-La., announced the day after Election Day he would not run for minority leader in the 120th Congress.

item.title: White House vows to press ahead with tariffs despite midterm backlash over rising prices
item.description: Business executives warned at a Washington summit of rising costs and shifting supply chains as polls showed growing opposition to Trump's tariffs.

item.title: Investors pivot to defensive stocks as markets enter a ‘state of alert’
item.description: Technology stocks have lost momentum while defensive sectors gain ground, as investors reassess risks.

item.title: Hundreds of schools in Italy, UK evacuated over 'hoax' bomb threats
item.description: Hundreds of schools across Europe were evacuated on Wednesday after receiving bomb threats, police forces say, amid growing worries of hybrid threats.

item.title: Hegseth impeachment effort torpedoed in House
item.description: GOP Rep. Thomas Massie, who has clashed with President Donald Trump, kicked off the Hegseth impeachment fight days after a blue wave midterm election.

item.title: Credit card debt climbs to a record $1.29 trillion, New York Fed research finds
item.description: As high prices continue to strain household budgets, many consumers have turned to credit cards to help make ends meet.

item.title: Homeowners tap equity as HELOC balances post biggest jump since 2005: New York Fed report
item.description: The rise in balances on HELOCs marks the 18th consecutive quarterly increase, according to a new report from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York.

item.title: Jim Cramer says Anthropic's explosive growth could justify a record-breaking IPO
item.description: "The fact that this deal is on is bullish for tech and the AI trade," CNBC's Jim Cramer said Tuesday.
